# Quillwend pricing — v1

Author: Maya · Date: 2026-06-12 · Status: proposal for the July kickoff

| Plan | Monthly | Annual |
|---|---|---|
| Solo | $6 per month | $60 per year ("two months free") |
| Team | $15 per seat per month | no annual option |

Free trial: 14 days, no card required.

## Rationale

- "Two months free" is easy to explain on a pricing page and is roughly a 17% discount.
- Team stays monthly-only in v1: we have no invoicing yet, and small teams churn in and out.
- No free tier. The trial is the free experience.

## Open questions

- Should Team get an annual plan once invoicing exists?
- Is 17% enough to move people to annual? Needs survey data.
